podcast.body: A loop sample of this song was used as a form of torture at the notorious Abu Ghraib prison in Iraq in 2008. One prisoner reported being stripped, handcuffed, and forced to listen to the song at such a high volume that he believed his head would burst. "One prisoner says that in 2008, he was stripped, handcuffed, and forced to listen to a loop sample of Babylon by David Gray at a volume so high he thought his head would burst."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
